page.overview:
Who is Alphonso Garracha?

Alfonso Garracha was a notorious Estalian pirate until his undoing in the southern seas of the Old World attracted the unwanted attentions of the Dwarfs of Barak Varr.

Alfonso Garracha's lair was stormed by a throng from Barak Varr comprised primarily of mercenaries, including the renowned Daddallo and his Birdmen of Catrazza.
